title: Hook Framework for Content
prompt:
Act as a content strategist and copywriter specialising in hooks.
Content topic     :  [WHAT THIS POST, EMAIL, OR VIDEO IS ABOUT]
Target audience :  [WHO WILL SEE THIS AND WHAT THEY CARE ABOUT]
Platform               :  [LINKEDIN / EMAIL / INSTAGRAM / YOUTUBE]
Core value            :  [WHAT THE READER WILL LEARN OR GET]
Write 5 hook variations using different hook types:
CURIOSITY HOOK         :  Creates a knowledge gap they must close
RELATABILITY HOOK   :  Opens with a situation they recognise
CONTROVERSY HOOK  :  Challenges a common belief in the space
VALUE HOOK                  :  Leads with the specific benefit upfront
STORY HOOK                  :  Opens mid-scene in a compelling moment
For each hook: write the opening line only (max 15 words).
Then recommend the strongest one for this audience.

PRO TIP
The curiosity hook is the most powerful but the most overused. The relatability hook is
the most underused  and often outperforms everything else because it makes the reader
feel seen before they've read a word of content. Start with: 'You know that moment
when...' and describe your audience's exact situation.
